name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-07-31, at wavelengths from 1.17 to 4.65 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
